LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SettingHandsMayHelp: Hands may help on new paddocks
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SettingHandsMayHelpDesc: When you mark a growing zone for machines, colonists may still sow and harvest it by hand. Off: machines alone work a new paddock until you turn "Hands may help" on for it.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SettingDriverCanFail: A machine's driver can fail a harvest, as by hand
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SettingDriverCanFailDesc: A combine's driver loses some plants to a failed harvest by the same chance a colonist harvesting by hand would: a skilled driver loses fewer.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_GizmoMachineWorkedDesc: Mark this growing zone as a paddock for machines. Tractors can then plough, cultivate and sow it and a combine harvest it, row by row, and colonists keep off it unless "Hands may help" is on.\n\nA crop no machine of yours sows or cuts still needs hands: turn "Hands may help" on for it.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_GizmoHandsMayHelpDesc: Let colonists sow and harvest this paddock by hand as well as machines. Off: they keep off it.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_PaddockMarked: {ZONE} is now a paddock for machines.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_PaddockUnmarked: {ZONE} is an ordinary growing zone again.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_HandsMayHelpOn: Colonists may sow and harvest {ZONE} by hand too.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_HandsMayHelpOff: Colonists keep off {ZONE}: machines alone work it.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_GizmoHarvestDesc: {VEHICLE} drives a paddock row by row, cutting every ripe plant its front takes into its grain tank. When the tank is full it drives to a chaser bin or bin with room, empties, and carries on. Unripe plants are left standing.\n\nFront: {FRONT}
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_NoFront: {VEHICLE} has no front fitted: fit a grain front first.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_TankHoldsOther: {VEHICLE}'s tank still holds {WHAT}, and takes one kind of grain at a time. Pour it out before harvesting {CROP}.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_NothingRipe: Nothing in {ZONE} is ready to harvest yet.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_HarvestFailedSome: {COUNT} plants were lost to failed cuts.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_LineNoFront: No front fitted: it cannot harvest
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_ImplementNotHeld: {IMPLEMENT} must be on a tractor's hitch to work.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_GizmoPloughDesc: The tractor drives a paddock row by row with {IMPLEMENT} lowered behind it, turning the soil: weeds, stubble and wild plants are buried. A sown crop is never touched, and trees are left standing. The heaviest work a tractor does.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_GizmoCultivateDesc: The tractor drives a paddock row by row with {IMPLEMENT} lowered behind it, clearing weeds and wild plants: a lighter pass than ploughing. A sown crop is never touched, and trees are left standing.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_GizmoSowDesc: The tractor drives a paddock row by row with {IMPLEMENT} behind it, sowing the paddock's crop in every empty cell. It sows with the crop's own grain if it holds some, cleaned as it goes, or with bought seed for any crop. It never cuts anything: clear the paddock first.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SowNeedsResearch: {CROP} cannot be sown until its research is done.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SowOutOfSeason: It is not the season to sow {CROP} here.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SowDriverSkill: Sowing {CROP} needs a driver with growing skill {LEVEL} or more.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_NoSeed: {IMPLEMENT} has no seed for {CROP}: pour in some of its grain, or bought seed.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_GizmoLowerDesc: Lower {IMPLEMENT} into the ground, so it works wherever the tractor drives it, not only on a paddock run: tillage clears weeds and wild plants and never a sown crop; a drill sows only a paddock it could sow on a run. It pulls hard while lowered. It stays lowered until you lift it or a paddock run starts.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_GizmoLiftDesc: Lift {IMPLEMENT} out of the ground. A paddock run still lowers it on each row.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_LoweredByHand: {IMPLEMENT} is lowered. It works wherever the tractor drives it.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SettingHandsUseSeedDesc: Off by default: colonists sow by hand for free, as the game does. On, for more realism: a colonist sowing a crop whose harvest is its own seed (grains, peas, oilseeds, corn) first takes a handful of that crop from a stockpile and uses it up as they sow, about three per cent of what each cell will yield. With none they can reach, they will not sow it, and say why. Cotton, hay, potatoes and crops of other mods with no crop class are still sown free.
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SettingFrameHay: Agricultural Frame: hay only from straw crops
LanguageData.PhobosFarming_SettingFrameHayDesc: The Dead Man's Switch - Legion's Agricultural Frame drops extra hay with every plant it harvests. On, for realism: only crops that leave straw or forage behind give it (grains, peas, chickpeas, canola, corn, sunflowers and haygrass), as the hay stands for their baled straw. Vegetables, fruit, root crops, cotton, flowers and herbs give none, nor do crops of other mods with no crop class. Off: hay from every plant, as its author made it. Takes effect at once.
